local flow=assert(F.Get(t.ID))
assert(flow.Phase=='RESULT',flow.Phase..':'..tostring(flow.Error))
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[t.ID])
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE','native absorption still incomplete')
local byID={};for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries) do byID[entry.ID]=entry end
assert(byID['live:person'].EscapeOutcome=='EXILE' and byID['live:person'].FinalOutcome=='EXILE')
assert(byID['live:artifact'].EscapeOutcome=='SCATTER' and byID['live:artifact'].FinalOutcome=='SCATTER')
assert(byID['live:governor'].Success==false and byID['live:governor'].RetryEscapeOutcome=='EXILE')
assert(byID['live:equipment'].Success==false and not byID['live:equipment'].RetryEscapeOutcome)
assert(byID['live:equipment'].FinalOutcome=='SEIZE' and byID['live:equipment'].Rolls.P3_RETRY_ESCAPE.Used==9999)
local roster=A.GetRoster(t.To)
assert(roster['live:equipment'] and roster['live:equipment'].Outcome=='SEIZE','neutral fallback did not seize equipment')
local returned=assert(byID['live:collection'])
assert(returned.SelectedAction=='RETURN' and returned.Success==true and returned.ReturnOwner~=t.From and returned.ReturnOwner~=t.To)
assert(A.GetRoster(returned.ReturnOwner)['live:collection'].Owner==returned.ReturnOwner,'return did not change real owner')
assert(roster['leader:'..t.From] and roster['live:religion'] and roster['live:unlock'],'leader/religion/unlock absent')
local fixture=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FLOW_LIVE_TEST'))
local gp=assert(roster['native-person:'..t.From..':'..fixture.GreatPerson])
assert(gp.Kind=='PERSON' and gp.Unit and gp.Unit.Owner==t.To,'native General person not transferred')
local gpUnit=assert(A.FindUnit(t.To,gp.Unit.Token))
assert(gpUnit:GetGreatPerson():GetIndividual()==e.Individual,'native Great Person individual changed')
for _,id in ipairs({'live:hero','live:hero-warlordB'}) do
  local entry=assert(byID[id])
  if entry.FinalOutcome=='SUICIDE' then
    assert(entry.TransferCause and A.GetState().Archive[id].SuicideCause==entry.TransferCause,
      'native Hero suicide lost cause')
  else
    local person=assert(roster[id],'native Hero missing from absorber')
    assert(person.Unit and A.FindUnit(t.To,person.Unit.Token),'native Hero has no live unit')
  end
end
for _,snapshot in ipairs(e.Cities) do
  local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(snapshot.X,snapshot.Y))
  assert(city:GetOwner()==t.To,'source city not transferred')
  local g=assert(city:GetProperty(A.Rules.GOVERNANCE_KEY))
  assert(g.Mode=='CONQUEST' and g.LoyaltyDelta==-15 and g.FrictionPerTurn==-2 and g.FrictionTurns==3)
  assert(g.ImmediateApplied and A.CityLoyalty(city)==math.max(0,math.min(100,g.ImmediateBefore-15)),
    'conquest loyalty method not applied to native city')
end
F.Tick()
for _,id in ipairs({'live:person','live:artifact','live:governor'}) do
  local world=assert(F.GetWorld(t.ID..':'..id),'escaped identity has no world reward')
  assert(world.AssetID==id and world.Status=='WAIT_CLEAR','escaped reward site not in native world: '..tostring(world.Error))
  local plot=assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(world.Site))
  assert(plot:GetImprovementType()==world.Improvement,'native reward improvement missing')
end
return 'results applied to native units, assets, cities and world reward sites'

local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local snapshot=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_RETURN_BOUNDARY'))
local owner=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_ReturnBoundaryNewOwner)
local flow=assert(F.Get(snapshot.ID))
assert(flow.Phase=='RESULT','corrected return never reached the result screen')
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[snapshot.ID])
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE','corrected absorption transaction is incomplete')
local returned
for _,entry in ipairs(flow.Entries) do
 if entry.ID==snapshot.Asset then returned=entry;break end
end
assert(returned and returned.SelectedAction=='RETURN' and returned.Success==true and
 returned.FinalOutcome=='RETURN' and returned.ReturnOwner==owner,
 'final successful return did not keep the corrected owner')
assert(A.Rules.Equal(returned.Rolls or {},snapshot.Frozen[snapshot.Asset].Rolls),
 'final return rerolled after destination invalidation')
assert(Players[snapshot.Recipient]:GetCities():GetCount()==0,
 'invalidated recipient acquired a city before completion')
local record=assert(A.GetRoster(owner)[snapshot.Asset])
assert(record.Owner==owner and record.Outcome=='RETURN',
 'actual returned collection did not reach the new recipient')
return 'reselected frozen RETURN completed with the same rolls and actual new owner'
